# Noyis Africa

> Premium Caribbean natural wellness and herbal health hub in St. John's, Antigua & Barbuda. Offers three signature Treasure herbal formulas (EC$40 each) with WhatsApp ordering.

Noyis Africa crafts premium Caribbean wellness formulas from natural herbs. The shop is located in the Neverland Building on Lower Nevis Street in St. John's, Antigua & Barbuda, open daily 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. Orders are placed via WhatsApp at +1 (268) 770-0171.
